newsitem.title: MEXICO: Arancia-Corn Products to begin fructose output.
newsitem.headline: Arancia-Corn Products to begin fructose output.

text.p: Arancia-Corn Products SA will start high fructose production toward the end of October at its plant in the state of Queretaro, a director of the company said Wednesday.
Sergio Castaneda, business director of the company, told Reuters in an interview the investment in the plant in the town of San Juan del Rio has totalled $120 million.

"We are about to start up the high fructose production plant," Castaneda said. He added the unit has an installed capacity of 18,000 tonnes per month and he envisaged it would operate "at practically 100 percent capacity."
Castaneda said the plant would be developed over three phases and this start-up was the first one. Following phases will expand capacity to reach 60,000 tonnes per month, he added.
Arancia Corn Products is a 51-49 percent joint venture born in 1995 between Arancia and the U.S. firm Corn Products, a division of CPC International Inc.

Arancia first started operations in the state of Jalisco 75 years ago as a company selling products to the textile industry. Currently, the company produces corn derivatives, such as starch glucose and soon high fructose. --Veronica Galan, Guadalajara bureau (523) 817-0440
